name: Message-trace observations (frozen UTC query)
description: Read bounded recipient trace metadata for one reviewed UTC date range and explicit filters. Subject is excluded unless deliberately selected; incomplete windows remain explicit.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.label: First UTC date
parameters.help: Inclusive first UTC day; within the rolling 90-day retention.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.label: Last UTC date
parameters.help: Inclusive final UTC day; today ends at the frozen review clock and remains incomplete.

parameters.name: Sender
parameters.label: Exact sender address
parameters.help: One exact SMTP address, without wildcards or display names.

parameters.name: Recipient
parameters.label: Exact recipient address
parameters.help: One exact SMTP address, without wildcards or display names.

parameters.name: InternetMessageId
parameters.label: Internet MessageId
parameters.help: Exact source MessageId; distinct from the service MessageTraceId GUID.

parameters.name: MessageTraceId
parameters.label: Service MessageTraceId
parameters.help: Exact canonical service GUID; needed for exhaustive high-recipient coverage.

parameters.name: IncludeSubject
parameters.label: Collect message subjects
parameters.help: Off by default. Subjects can contain sensitive content and are retained only when explicitly reviewed.

parameters.name: MaximumRows
parameters.label: Total row limit
parameters.help: Total observations plus all interval diagnostics; saturation remains incomplete.

prerequisites: Approved installed ExchangeOnlineManagement supporting Get-MessageTraceV2 and the Message Tracking role. Module/RBAC/live behaviour is unverified. Review expires after300 seconds; no installation, retry or fallback.
limitations: Read-only metadata; never deployment before-evidence or change authority.
One frozen UTC review, at most nine contiguous ten-day windows,5000 total rows,100 source calls and300 seconds including authentication.
General queries may omit high-recipient messages; exact MessageTraceId is required for a complete claim. Current-day results remain incomplete.
Subjects are omitted by default. Raw Size has no inferred unit; source identity and unknown values are preserved.
Repeated recipient identities refuse the affected window instead of silent deduplication. Failed windows are not retried.
